name: Delicious Harbor Fish Burger
desc: A fish burger. The hearty bread, tender fish, and crunchy toppings create a collision of textures that compels one to devour it in great, eager bites. Local rumors claim some families have uprooted their entire lives to Dornman Port just for a daily taste of this authentic delicacy. It seems those tales were no exaggeration...

value.text: Increases all party members' Max HP by 25% for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
